name: VNDC
collateral: Vietnamese dong reserves self-reported by Jade Labs (the VNDC issuer) and tracked across Polygon and BNB Smart Chain deployments; no formal independent attestation is published
pegMechanism: 1:1 fiat-collateralized issuer mint and redemption operated by Jade Labs through the ONUS and VNDC Hub platforms; users on-ramp/off-ramp VND through Vietnamese banking partners

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: centralized issuer with discretionary mint/redeem authority; contract source not independently audited and ONUS deployment retains administrative pause and reissue privileges.
blacklistabilityReview.reviewer: Pharos lane D Wave 3 non-USD review

notices.title: Attestation gap and peg-currency placeholder
notices.message: VNDC is pegged to the Vietnamese dong, but Pharos does not yet support VND as a first-class peg currency, so the asset is tracked under pegCurrency: "OTHER" pending a coordinated VND addition across formatting, FX, and price-validation pipelines. Separately, aggregator-reported market cap (~$50M) does not consistently match on-chain Polygon/BSC supply, and reserves are self-disclosed by the issuer without independent audit cadence.
